profile.text:
Originally a Sargonsoldier, Spot took the initiative and came to Rhodes Island seeking employment himself. After passing the examination battery, he was assigned to Reserve Op Team A6.
He has a lot of experience as a guard; and serves as the defensive specialist on the team.
